SPECIALIZED CARRIERS
Certain specialized motor carriers (automobile trans porters, carriers of liquid and dry commodities in bulk, and movers of household goods) urge that the transportation of the commodities they handle be fully or partially excluded from the proposed regulations. These carriers fear diversion of their traffic to new unregulated carriers entering the market within the expanded zones. They also assert that because Commission regulations will not apply to operations conducted entirely within the zone, unsafe operations will result. They also argue that zone expansion will adversely affect the environment. The household goods carriers further contend that zone expansion will give rise to discriminatory rate practices and a decrease in consumer protection.
